behavior_constraints: The project must build with go build and the server must run.
Registering a model accepts name, framework, description, and optional tags.
Creating a version auto-increments version numbers from 1, stores metrics map, tags list, optional model_config, and starts the version in development stage.
PromoteVersion only permits development to staging, development to archived, staging to production, staging to archived, and production to archived; invalid transitions are rejected.
At most one version per model may be in production; promoting a version to production automatically archives any existing production version for that model.
GET model details returns the model's versions sorted by version number descending.
ListModels supports optional framework and tag query filters.
DELETE model returns 404 when the model does not exist and, when deleting, unloads the model from the serving cache if it is loaded.
Pipeline execution supports steps with name, type, config, and dependency names.
Execution order is determined by topological sort and cycles are rejected.
entities.summary: Round 1 demands that the server build and run and that the registry, pipeline engine, experiment tracker, and model serving subsystems fully conform to their specified lifecycle, execution, aggregation, and inference contracts.

instruction_head:
**gomlops** is a Go-based ML model lifecycle management platform built as a monolithic HTTP service. We are planning a major modernization effort, but before any migration work can begin, the system must pass a thorough validation against its original design contracts.

Build and run the server (`cd /app && go build -o gomlops . && ./gomlops`), then verify each subsystem against the contracts below. Fix every deficiency you find so the system fully conforms.

---

## Model Registry

- Register n

behavior_constraints: GET /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/compare?versions=1,2,3 compares specified versions, returns versions array sorted ascending by number, plus metric_summary covering every metric in any version with min/max/first/last/improvement(last-first)/mean and trend (improving/degrading/stable)
Version compare returns 404 if model missing, 400 if any requested version missing, fewer than 2 versions specified, or duplicate version numbers in query
POST /api/v1/pipelines/templates creates a named template (201), name must match [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+ and be <=64 chars (400 otherwise), 409 on duplicate name
GET /api/v1/pipelines/templates lists all templates sorted alphabetically by name ascending by default, with ?sort=created_at sorting by creation time ascending
GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/pipelines/templates/{name} retrieve/update/delete a template; PUT sets updated_at and returns 404 if missing; DELETE returns 404 if missing
Template response objects include name, description, parameters (null when none declared), pipeline, created_at, and updated_at (null until updated)
POST /api/v1/pipelines/templates/{name}/execute runs the template pipeline via the standard engine with input and optional params, returning 404 if template missing
Templates are stored in-memory only
POST /api/v1/serving/batch processes multiple inference requests; strategy defaults to independent; stop_on_error skips subsequent requests with status 'skipped'

Batch response includes results (with model_name, version, predictions, latency_ms on success; model_name and error on failure; model_name and status 'skipped' for skipped), total_latency_ms, and summary with total/succeeded/failed (plus skipped for stop_on_error)
affected_prior: ExecuteTransform (normalize zero-range behavior change)
ExecuteAggregate (new 'range' operation)
AggregateMetric (run_ids field added to response)
ExecutePipeline / NewEngine / Execute (template execution reuses engine; variable context system hinted)

Infer / serving subsystem (batch inference wraps individual inference)
entities.summary: This round adds model version comparison, pipeline templates with CRUD and execution, batch inference with independent/stop_on_error strategies, fixes normalize zero-range and experiment aggregation run identification, adds a 'range' aggregate operation, and begins a pipeline variable context system.

instruction_head:
We're starting the first phase of platform enhancements. Below are three new capabilities to add (each with deeper requirements than a basic implementation), two behavior corrections, one new aggregation function, and five system-integration features that modify existing subsystems.

---

## New Capabilities

### Model Version Comparison

Add an endpoint for comparing metrics across specific versions of a model:

- **GET /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/compare?versions=1,2,3** — Compare the speci

behavior_constraints: Normalize transform maps to [-1,1] using formula 2*(x-min)/(max-min)-1 and returns 0.0 for zero-range
Promoting a new version to production demotes the old production version to staging instead of archived
weighted_mean aggregation reads weights from run.Metrics instead of run.Parameters, skipping runs lacking the weight metric
Template execution response includes template_info with template_name, resolved_params, and defaults_used (alphabetically sorted)
GET /api/v1/models/{name} response includes stage_summary with integer counts for all four stages (development, staging, production, archived)

Pipeline steps with skip_condition in config are skipped when the referenced variable exists and the condition evaluates true; skipped steps output {"status":"skipped","data":[]} and do not apply set_vars or output_transform
Skip condition supports operators gt, lt, eq, gte, lte, ne; missing variable means condition is ignored and step executes normally

GET /api/v1/experiments/{name}/metrics/{metric}/history returns chronological history of a metric across runs with run_id and value, count field; 404 if experiment missing, 400 with 'no values found' if no runs have the metric
PUT /api/v1/experiments/{name}/runs/{id} updates run metrics (new keys added, existing overwritten); returns updated run; 404 if experiment or run missing

POST /api/v1/experiments/{name}/runs/search filters runs by metric conditions (gt, lt, gte, lte, eq) with AND logic; runs missing a filtered metric are excluded; empty filters returns all runs; 404 if experiment missing; response includes runs array and count
affected_prior: ExecuteTransform normalize logic in internal/pipeline/steps.go (range change from [0,1] to [-1,1])
PromoteVersion in internal/registry/registry.go (demotion target change from archived to staging)
AggregateMetric weighted_mean in internal/experiment/experiment.go (weight source change from Parameters to Metrics)
ExecuteTemplate in internal/api/templates.go (response shape change with added template_info)
GetModel handler in internal/api/handlers.go (added stage_summary field)
entities.summary: This round changes normalize to [-1,1], production demotion to staging, weighted_mean weights to metrics, adds template_info and stage_summary fields, and introduces pipeline step skip conditions plus experiment metric history, run metric update, and run search endpoints.

## Behavioral Changes (Conflicts)

### Normalize Transform — Symmetric Range [-1, 1]

The normalize transform now maps values to the **[-1, 1]** range instead of [0, 1]:

- New formula: `2 * (x - min) / (max - min) - 1`
- When all values are identical (zero range), return **0.0** (the midpoint of [-1, 1]).
- This replaces the previous [0, 1] normalization a

CompareExperiments returns 400 if fewer than 2 experiment names are specified or metric parameter is missing
CompareExperiments returns 404 if any named experiment does not exist
CompareExperiments returns 400 with a message containing 'no data' if none of the specified experiments have any runs with the metric
Experiments with no runs having the metric are excluded from the experiments array
POST /api/v1/models/{name}/versions/{num}/annotations creates an annotation with created_at timestamp and returns 409 on duplicate key
Annotation key must be non-empty and contain only letters, digits, underscores; otherwise return 400
